body:
Yes, this probably affects the Chrome implementation.

If you still have access to the device can you get its HID report descriptor? You can use `ioreg` on macOS:

    ioreg -c IOHIDInterface

There should be a line with `"ReportDescriptor" = <...>`, the byte values are the report descriptor.

The only thing I can find with that command is this:

    | |   +-o Fairbanks Scales SCB-R9000@14130000  <class AppleUSBDevice, id 0x1000255d0, registered, matched, active, busy 0 (7 ms), retain 14>


I ran the command with the device not attached, then with it attached and diff'd the results. 
I see other devices reporting the ReportDescriptor, but not this one.
